cohort: 200 pregnant patients at Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna, India. 100 patients had MSAF and 100 patients had clear amniotic fluid (controls).
finding: While MSAF was associated with increased frequency of operative delivery, poor neonatal outcomes, and increased NICU admission, there was no statistically significant difference in neonatal outcome between the MSAF group and the control group.
